```{r rename bins to have informative names}
# Function to rename files with a specific pattern
rename_files <- function(directory, pattern) {
  # Get all files in the directory that match the pattern .[\d+].fa
  files <- list.files(directory, pattern = "\\.\\d+\\.fa", full.names = TRUE, all.files = TRUE)
  
  # Loop over each file and rename
  for (file in files) {
    # Extract the numeric value using regex
    num_value <- str_extract(file, "\\d+")
    
    # Extract the original filename without the path
    original_filename <- basename(file)
    
    # Create the new filename, appending the original name to ensure uniqueness
    new_name <- paste0(directory, "/", pattern, num_value, "_", original_filename)
    
    # Rename the file
    file.rename(file, new_name)
  }
}
# Specify the directories and their new patterns
dir1 <- "/scratch/users/rsalcedo/orca_RSG/metabat/Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_bins"
pattern1 <- "Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_"

dir2 <- "/scratch/users/rsalcedo/orca_RSG/metabat/Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_bins"
pattern2 <- "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_"

# Rename files in both directories with different patterns
rename_files(dir1, pattern1)
rename_files(dir2, pattern2)

setwd(dir1)
file_names <- list.files()
new_file_names <- gsub("_10_\\.", "_", file_names)
file.rename(from = file_names, to = new_file_names)
list.files()

setwd(dir2)
file_names <- list.files()
new_file_names <- gsub("_5_\\.", "_", file_names)
file.rename(from = file_names, to = new_file_names)
list.files()
```

```{r kofamscan thresholding, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for(i in binlist) {                                           
  kegg = read_csv(paste(rootdir, "bin_analysis/kofamscan/csv/", i, "_KEGGIDs.csv", sep = ""), col_names = TRUE)
  kegg$score = as.integer(kegg$score)
  kegg$threshold = as.integer(kegg$threshold)
  kegg = rename(kegg, gene = "Gene name") 
  kegg = rename(kegg, KO = "KO number") 
  kegg = rename(kegg, evalue = "e-value") 
  kegg_besthit = kegg %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>% 
    slice_max(score)
  kegg_besthit = subset(kegg_besthit, kegg_besthit$evalue < 1e-6)
  kegg_besthit = subset(kegg_besthit, kegg_besthit$score >= 0.8*threshold)
  write.csv(kegg_besthit, file = paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/kofamscan/csv_processed/", i, "_processed.csv"))
}

```

# bowtie mapping for sam files for iRep
```{r create output directory}
dir.create(paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/"))
dir.create(paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/indexes/"))
dir.create(paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/sams/"))
```

```{r build index}
# Generate commands for building Bowtie indexes
index_commands <- vector("list", length(drep_binlist))
index <- 1

for (bin in drep_binlist) {
  # Define input file path for each bin (assuming bins are in .fa format)
  bin_fasta <- paste0(drepdir, bin, ".fa")
  
  # Define output index prefix
  index_prefix <- paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/indexes/", bin)
  
  # Create the Bowtie build command
  command <- paste0("sbatch -J ", bin, "_map -c 20 --mem-per-cpu 4G -p serc -t 160:00:00 --wrap 'bowtie2-build ", bin_fasta, " ", index_prefix, "'")
  
  # Store command in list
  index_commands[[index]] <- command
  index <- index + 1
}

# Convert list to character vector and write to file
sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_bowtie_index_build.sh"))
  cat(unlist(index_commands), sep = "\n")
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_bowtie_index_build.sh"))
```

```{r mapping command}
# Loop through each bin and sample to generate Bowtie commands
commands <- vector("list", length(drep_binlist) * length(sample_list))
index <- 1

for (bin in drep_binlist) {
  for (sample in in_situ_samples) {
    # Define input file paths based on sample names
    forward_reads <- paste0(seqdir, "trimmed_reads/", sample, "_R1_trimmed.fastq")
    reverse_reads <- paste0(seqdir, "trimmed_reads/", sample, "_R2_trimmed.fastq")
    
    # Define output SAM file
    output_sam <- paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/sams/", sample, "_to_", bin, ".sam")
    
    # Create the Bowtie command
    command <- paste0("sbatch -J ", bin, "_map -c 20 --mem-per-cpu 4G -p serc -t 160:00:00 --wrap 'bowtie2 -x ", rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/indexes/", bin, " -1 ", forward_reads, " -2 ", reverse_reads, " -S ", output_sam, "'")
    
    # Store command in list
    commands[[index]] <- command
    index <- index + 1
  }
}

# Print or write the commands to a file if needed
sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_bowtie_map.sh"))
  cat(unlist(commands), sep = "\n") 
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_bowtie_map.sh"))
```

```{r convert to bam, sort, and index}
# Define directories
sam_dir <- paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/sams/")
bam_dir <- paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/bowtie/bams/")

# Create the BAM output directory if it doesn't exist
dir.create(bam_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# List all SAM files
sam_files <- list.files(sam_dir, pattern = "\\.sam$", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize command lists
view_commands <- vector("list", length(sam_files))
sort_commands <- vector("list", length(sam_files))
index_commands <- vector("list", length(sam_files))

# Loop through each SAM file to create commands for each step
index <- 1
for (sam_file in sam_files) {
  # Define BAM file name
  bam_file <- gsub(".sam$", ".bam", basename(sam_file))
  sorted_bam_file <- gsub(".bam$", "_sorted.bam", bam_file)
  
  # Full paths for output files
  bam_path <- paste0(bam_dir, bam_file)
  sorted_bam_path <- paste0(bam_dir, sorted_bam_file)
  
  # Create samtools view command (SAM to BAM)
  view_commands[[index]] <- paste0("samtools view -S -b ", sam_file, " > ", bam_path)
  
  # Create samtools sort command (sort BAM)
  sort_commands[[index]] <- paste0("samtools sort ", bam_path, " -o ", sorted_bam_path)
  
  # Create samtools index command (index sorted BAM)
  index_commands[[index]] <- paste0("samtools index ", sorted_bam_path)
  
  index <- index + 1
}

# Write each set of commands to separate files
sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_convert_to_bam.sh"))
cat(unlist(view_commands), sep = "\n")
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_convert_to_bam.sh"))


sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_sort_bam.sh"))
cat(unlist(sort_commands), sep = "\n")
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_sort_bam.sh"))


sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_index_bam.sh"))
cat(unlist(index_commands), sep = "\n")
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/bin_index_bam.sh"))
```

# iRep
```{r generate irep command}
output_dir <- paste0(rootdir, "genome_iRep_outputs/")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Initialize command list
iRep_commands <- vector("list", length(drep_binlist) * length(sample_list))

# Generate iRep commands
index <- 1
for (bin in drep_binlist) {
  for (sample in sample_list) {
    # Define genome and SAM file paths for each bin and sample
    genome_file <- paste0(drepdir, bin, ".fa")
    sam_file <- paste0(sam_dir, sample, "_to_", bin, ".sam")
    output_file <- paste0(output_dir, bin, "_", sample, ".iRep")
    
    # Create iRep command
    command <- paste0("sbatch -J ", bin, "_map -c 20 --mem-per-cpu 4G -p serc -t 160:00:00 --wrap 'iRep -f ", genome_file, " -s ", sam_file, " -o ", output_file, "'")
    
    # Store command
    iRep_commands[[index]] <- command
    index <- index + 1
  }
}

# Write the commands to a file
sink(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/genome_iRep_commands.sh"))
cat(unlist(iRep_commands), sep = "\n")
sink()
file.show(paste0(rootdir, "sh_scripts/genome_iRep_commands.sh"))
```

```{r parsing iRep results}
setwd("/scratch/users/rsalcedo/orca_RSG/genome_iRep_outputs")
system("iRep_filter.py --long -t *.tsv > combined_irep_results.tsv")
setwd(rootdir)

iRep = read_tsv(paste0(rootdir, "/genome_iRep_outputs/combined_irep_results.tsv"))


# Initialize an empty list to store results
results <- list()

# Loop through each iRep.tsv file in the specified directory
files <- list.files(paste0(rootdir, "/genome_iRep_outputs/"), pattern = ".iRep.tsv", full.names = TRUE)

for (item in files) {
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store the information
  info <- list()
  
  # Read the file line by line
  lines <- readLines(item)
  
  # Create a new column 'source_file' to store the filename
  info$source_file <- rep(basename(item), length(lines))  # Replicate the filename for each line
  
  for (i in 1:length(lines)) {
    line <- lines[i]
    
    # Check for lines starting with "##"
    if (grepl("##", line)) {
      if (i == 1) {
        field <- "genome"
      } else {
        field <- paste(strsplit(line, " ")[[1]][-1], collapse = "_")
      }
      
    # Check for lines not starting with "#"
    } else if (!grepl("#", line)) {
      if (field == "genome") {
        info[[field]] <- c(info[[field]], basename(strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]][1]))
      } else {
        info[[field]] <- c(info[[field]], strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]][2])
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create a dataframe from the collected information and append to results list
  results[[length(results) + 1]] <- as.data.frame(info)
}

# Combine all dataframes into one
all_results <- bind_rows(results)

# Rename the 'source_file' column to 'sample'
all_results$sample <- gsub("^.*(?:Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_|Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_)[0-9]+_(.*)$", "\\1", all_results$source_file)
all_results$sample <- gsub(".iRep.tsv", "", all_results$sample)

# Remove the 'source_file' column
all_results <- all_results %>% select(-source_file)

all_results <- all_results %>% distinct()

unique(all_results$sample)

View(all_results)

# Write the combined dataframe to a TSV file
write.table(all_results, paste0(rootdir, "/genome_iRep_outputs/combined_irep_results.csv"), sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(all_results, "~/combined_irep_results.csv", sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
